name: Investment Fund Order
definition: An investor's instruction to either subscribe or redeem an amount of money or its equivalent, for example other assets, into or out of an investment fund.

GrossAmountIndicator.name: Gross Amount Indicator
GrossAmountIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an ordered amount is a gross amount (including all charges, commissions, tax). If it is not a gross amount, the ordered amount is a net amount (amount to be invested or redeemed from the fund to which other elements will be added).

OrderType.name: Order Type
OrderType.definition: Specifies the category of the investment fund order.

GrossAmount.name: Gross Amount
GrossAmount.definition: Amount of money used to derive the quantity of investment fund units sold or subscribed, before deduction of charges, commissions, and taxes, expressed in the currency requested by the investor.|[Quantity * Price] + (Charges + Commissions +Taxes)]

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount of money used to determine the quantity of investment fund units to be subscribed or to be sold.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the order was placed by the investor.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date on which the order expires.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of an investor with respect to an investment fund order.

RequestedSettlementCurrency.name: Requested Settlement Currency
RequestedSettlementCurrency.definition: Currency requested for settlement of cash proceeds.

RequestedExecutionDateTime.name: Requested Execution Date Time
RequestedExecutionDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the investor requests the order to be executed.

FinancialAdvice.name: Financial Advice
FinancialAdvice.definition: Specifies if advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

NegotiatedTrade.name: Negotiated Trade
NegotiatedTrade.definition: Specifies whether the trade is negotiated.

HoldingsRate.name: Holdings Rate
HoldingsRate.definition: Percentage of the financial quantity to be invested or redeemed.

OrderWaiverReason.name: Order Waiver Reason
OrderWaiverReason.definition: Reason why an order has to be handled differently, probably in a manual fashion, because for example, the investment manager has agreed a waiver to the extended terms.

InitialOrderIndicator.name: Initial Order Indicator
InitialOrderIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the subscription order is an initial order.

OrderBookingDate.name: Order Booking Date
OrderBookingDate.definition: Date and time an investment fund order is registered on the books of either the fund or its designated agent, eg, transfer agent.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total amount subscribed in the current tax year.

RelatedTransaction.name: Related Transaction
RelatedTransaction.definition: Transaction which is the source of the order.

UnitsNumber.name: Units Number
UnitsNumber.definition: Quantity of investment fund units to be subscribed or redeemed.

InvestmentFundOrderExecution.name: Investment Fund Order Execution
InvestmentFundOrderExecution.definition: Execution of an investment fund order.

InvestmentPlan.name: Investment Plan
InvestmentPlan.definition: Investment plan which triggers the standing orders.

OrderStatus.name: Order Status
OrderStatus.definition: Status of an investment fund order.
